definitions.gloss: managing director; executive director; senior managing director
definitions.explanation: An executive officer of a Japanese company who handles the day-to-day operations under the president. The rank typically sits between {取締役|とりしまりやく} (director) and {専務|せんむ} (senior managing director). Short for {常務|じょうむ}{取締役|とりしまりやく}.

examples.japanese: {常務|じょうむ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出席|しゅっせき}した→出席する：01830_shussekisuru⟧。
examples.english: The managing director attended the meeting.

examples.japanese: ⟦{先月|せんげつ}→先月：00751_sengetsu⟧、⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{常務|じょうむ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{昇進|しょうしん}→昇進：04553_shoushin⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Last month, he was promoted to managing director.

examples.japanese: {常務|じょうむ}⟦{取締役|とりしまりやく}→取締役：12124_torishimariyaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{専務|せんむ}→専務：19291_senmu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{補佐|ほさ}→補佐：19834_hosa⟧し、⟦{日常|にちじょう}→日常：01595_nichijou⟧⟦{業務|ぎょうむ}→業務：09630_gyoumu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{執行|しっこう}→執行：18996_shikkou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{担当|たんとう}→担当：02567_tantou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The managing director assists the president and senior managing director, and is responsible for executing day-to-day business.

notes:
Short for {常務|じょうむ}⟦{取締役|とりしまりやく}→取締役：12124_torishimariyaku⟧ (literally 'standing-duty director'). Refers both to the title and to the person holding it.

COMPANY RANK ORDER (high to low):
- ⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧: president (CEO)
- {副社長|ふくしゃちょう}: vice president
- ⟦{専務|せんむ}→専務：19291_senmu⟧: senior managing director
- {常務|じょうむ}: managing director
- ⟦{取締役|とりしまりやく}→取締役：12124_torishimariyaku⟧: director (board member)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {常務|じょうむ}⟦{取締役|とりしまりやく}→取締役：12124_torishimariyaku⟧: managing director (full title)
- {常務|じょうむ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{昇進|しょうしん}→昇進：04553_shoushin⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to be promoted to managing director
- {常務|じょうむ}{会|かい}: management meeting of executive officers
